name: Player facts
notes: Facts about the player character that dialogue, quests and level variants gate on through conditions (mw-e27.5).

facts.description: The class the player chose at new game (mw-e19.5). Written once by apply-class; "none" only before the choice. Class-gated dialogue options and quest branches read it, e.g. { "fact": "player.class", "eq": "thief" }.
